game.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
game.blurb: Open-world fantasy action RPG in which the witcher Geralt of Rivia hunts monsters across Velen, Novigrad and Skellige, from CD PROJEKT RED, released 2015-05-18. RAWG average playtime: 43 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Geralt follows a trail across Velen, Novigrad and Skellige. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Finishing the Game and Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finishing the story, including on "Blood and Broken Bones!" and "Death March!".

chapters.title: Combat, Signs and Character Growth
chapters.summary: Signs, counterattacks, crossbow headshots, using the environment, ability trees and character level.

chapters.title: Alchemy, Bombs and Witcher Gear
chapters.summary: Potion and bomb formulae, mutagen slots, books and witcher gear sets.

chapters.title: Contracts, Exploration and Side Activities
chapters.summary: Monster contracts and nests, fast travel points, Places of Power, fistfights and horse races.

chapters.title: Gwent
chapters.summary: Collecting cards, winning tricky rounds and the tournament at the Passiflora.

chapters.title: Hearts of Stone (expansion, likely)
chapters.summary: A block of mostly hidden achievements after the base game, including Ofieri gear. Placed by list position.

chapters.title: Blood and Wine (expansion)
chapters.summary: Travelling to Toussaint, the knights' tourney, Corvo Bianco, Aerondight, grandmaster diagrams and mutations.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 292030)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (witcher.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://witcher.fandom.com/wiki/The_Witcher_3:_Wild_Hunt
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt" or "The Witcher 3", and a StrategyWiki search for "Witcher 3" returned nothing, so there is no guide to use there. witcher.fandom.com answers the API, with about 138 linked pages, including "Hearts of Stone", "Blood and Wine", "The Witcher 3 main quests" and "The Witcher 3 contracts"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is 292030, now listed as "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered"; its schema gives no game name. RAWG's entry is the 2015 game (id 3328). 26 of 78 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Blood and Wine is placed by the places and items its descriptions name (Toussaint, Corvo Bianco, Aerondight and so on) and by position (achievements 66 to 78, including "I Have a Gwent Problem" and "Dressed to Kill"). Achievements 53 to 64 were grouped as Hearts of Stone by schema position only; that name is an inference from RAWG and Fandom listing the expansion, not stated in the achievement text. "Killed It" (65) sits on the border between the two blocks and was put in Gwent. The other 14 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; "Triple Threat", "What Was That?" and "Geralt: The Professional" are probably not story beats.
